bullets.original: High-resilience soft foam with a reinforced support frame forms a deep, contoured seat that follows the natural curves of your back. Even with daily use, it maintains its shape, reducing muscle pressure. The extra-wide seat width and 24.4" depth, combined with double-layer thickened seat cushions, ensure ample space for relaxed seating. Each seat comes with a lumbar pillow for added lower-back support
bullets.rewrite: Cloud Cushion Comfort — High-resilience foam and a reinforced frame create a deep, contoured seat that supports your body's natural curves. The 24.4" extra-wide seat depth accommodates lounging or sitting upright, while each seat includes a lumbar pillow for lower-back support during long evenings.

bullets.original: The fabric features a smooth texture that's gentle on the skin for year-round comfort. Its fade-resistant, scratch-proof surface is easy to wipe clean, keeping the sofa looking fresh with minimal effort
